title: Data drop: what a batch of look-alike ads costs each ad
hook: Six or more look-alike ads launched within three days: each got 48% less first-month spend.
caption:
Six or more look-alike ads launched within three days: each got 48% less first-month spend.

That is from our analysis of new video ads launched May to Sep 2026 across brands we work with.

New ads that looked like many already running got 36% less. A proven message in a new look got 47% more.

Our reading: near-copies compete for the same people, and none gets a fair start.

Before your next batch, lay the first frames side by side. If two match, change one or hold it back.

Save this for launch day and follow @galvor.ai.

items: Lay the first frames side by side
If two look the same, change one or hold it
Keep the message that works, change the look
Do not launch near-copies within the same three days

notes:
Reader: a growth lead who launches creative in batches. One argument: near-copies launched together starve each other, so check first frames and space them. Numbers used, all from the facts bank (Decoded #3, Galvor analysis of new video ads launched May to Sep 2026): 48% less (six or more look-alikes within three days), 36% less (looked like many running ads), 47% more (proven message in a new look). The 'compete with each other' slide is labelled as our reading, not a measured finding. Topic kept.
